LOGIC & PROBLEM-SOLVING WORKSHEETS

Logic & Problem-Solving worksheets — free printables for age 4.

Patterns, odd ones, keys and clues — the printable twins of the Logic Adventures, each with a grown-up answer line. Every sheet twins with a real game in Logic, Thinking & Problem-Solving (Class 30) — download the PDF, print from the page, or play online.
